reason: Acceptance criteria R1-R9 are the pass/fail contract the check verifies: seam freeze + credential-isolation contract test, additive migrations, trigger/series-key behavior, bounded repo read, schema-validated evidence-cited diagnosis routing, RBAC console without secrets, budget/audit limits, and the forward-compatibility proof.
Confirms the implementation matches the frozen port signatures, strict agent envelope, state-machine subset (reserved states unreachable), read-only tool gateway, and in-process/Effect seam shape.
Validation gates (build, vet, tests) and testing/comment expectations the check must run and enforce before reporting completion.
Verify HTTP envelope usage, DecodeJSON unknown-field rejection, stable codes, error wrapping, and that config errors name env keys not raw values.
Verify no credentials, raw provider requests/responses, plaintext secrets, repository archives, or unrestricted logs are persisted or logged (R7/R9 privacy invariants).
Verify migrations are additive, use the advisory-lock pattern, and that every mutable table carries version bigint optimistic locking; existing incident/project data stays readable and writable.
Verify module boundaries: application/domain import no HTTP/env/pgx/redis, adapters own concrete clients, and no deferred outbox/RabbitMQ/worker/placeholder package was introduced.
Verify real adapters stay behind frozen ports, keep secrets inside adapters, and populate RepoRef/EvidenceScope with project UUIDs and credential-free remotes.
